title: Keep a proposed successor discoverable after delivery
preconditions: Disposable Saga with baseline commit before a new identity, proposed r1, implemented r2 supported by exact evidence, and same-identity proposed successor r3 against r2; retain a comparison head and a separate conflicted entity.

steps.action: Query proposed work at r2 and new entities against the recorded baseline/head.
steps.expected_result: r2 is absent from proposed results but the identity remains new in the comparison.

steps.action: Query proposed work after r3 and inspect unresolved records and saved baseline.
steps.expected_result: r3 is discoverable as proposed, r2 remains implemented, and conflicts are visible without choosing a winner.
